summary.text: Ron Kouchi represents District 8 in the Hawaii State Senate and has been Senate President since 2015.

paragraphs.text: He was born in Los Angeles, attended Drake University, and served on the Kauai County Council for 22 years, including 12 years as its chair.
Gov. Linda Lingle appointed Kouchi to the state Senate on September 7, 2010, after the incumbent resigned to run for lieutenant governor.
